label: server/corpus.ts full-file compaction
summary: Validates corpus paths, enforces root and symlink boundaries, implements filesystem-backed directory and line access, and exposes provider selection and document-reading facades.

sections.comment:
CorpusPathSecurity
|
+--> DEPENDENCIES
|    `--> filesystem metadata + canonical paths + domain contracts
|
+--> VALIDATE RELATIVE PATH
|    `--> function relativeSegments(...)
|         +--[invalid]--> reject NUL, backslashes, absolute/empty/dot segments
|         `--[valid]----> split normalized POSIX segments
|
+--> CANONICAL ROOT
|    `--> async function canonicalBindingRoot(...)
|         +--> require provider binding kind
|         `--> realpath(root) -> require directory
|
`--> RESOLVE WITHIN ROOT
     `--> async function resolveWithoutSymlinks(...)
          +--> relativeSegments(...) -> lstat each path component
          +--[missing/link/escape]--> reject traversal
          `--[safe]----------------> resolved filesystem path

FilesystemCorpusAccess
|
+--> PROVIDER CONTRACT
|    `--> class FilesystemCorpusProvider implements CorpusProvider
|         `--> constructor(...)
|
+--> LIST
|    `--> async listDirectory(...)
|         +--> canonical root -> safe directory path
|         +--> readdir -> omit .git -> classify directories/files
|         `--> directory-first stable sort -> normalized listing
|
+--> READ RANGE
|    `--> async readLines(...)
|         +--[invalid range]--> reject
|         `--> readDocumentLines(...) -> inclusive slice
|
`--> READ DOCUMENT
     `--> async readDocumentLines(...)
          +--> canonical root -> safe file path -> require file
          `--> UTF-8 read -> newline split

CorpusProviderRegistry
|
+--> PUBLIC CAPABILITY
|    `--> type ReadableCorpusProvider = CorpusProvider + readDocumentLines(...)
|
+--> INSTANCES
|    `--> const providers = { git-worktree, filesystem-documents }
|         `--> each binding kind -> FilesystemCorpusProvider
|
`--> SELECT
     `--> export function corpusProvider(...)
          `--> binding.kind -> matching readable provider

CorpusReadFacade
|
`--> READ
     `--> export async function readCorpusDocumentLines(...)
          `--> corpusProvider(binding).readDocumentLines(...)
